# Penny Telfer

**Role:** Mark's biological mother
**Residence:** Redcliffe, Queensland
**Spouse (1st):** Timothy Neil Telfer (m. 28 Nov 1981, Redcliffe Churches of Christ Chapel, Kippa Ring — div.)
---

## Family

| Relation | Name |
|----------|------|
| **Spouse (1st)** | [[Timothy Neil Telfer (1959–?)]] (m. 28 Nov 1981 — div.) |
| **Children** | [[Mark Kenneth Telfer (1986–?)]], [[Amy Nicole Telfer]], [[David Telfer]] |

---

## Life Summary

Mark's biological mother. Loves animals, driving, speedway, fishing, and rodeos. Went to Clontarf Beach State High School. Former checkout chick at Kmart. Lives in Redcliffe, Queensland. First married Timothy Neil Telfer on 28 November 1981 at Redcliffe Churches of Christ Chapel, Kippa Ring (divorced).

---

## Marriage — Penny Ann Virgen & Timothy Neil Telfer (28 Nov 1981)

Married at Church of Christ Redcliffe, Kippa Ring, Queensland.

- **Parents of bride:** Kenneth Gregory Virgen & Noela Pauline Wode
- **Parents of groom:** Murray John Telfer & Shirley Edna Parker

*Full certificate held in private family records.*
